title: Notpump
tagline: Empowers communities to grow new ERC-404 (or DN-404) standard using fungible and non-fungible tokens, achieving bonding curve fulfillment
description: NotPump is an innovative protocol designed to revolutionize the NFT ecosystem by leveraging DN404 tokens, which build upon the advanced principles of the ERC-404 standard. This protocol addresses several key issues in the current NFT and token markets, such as liquidity challenges, fair token distribution, and the need for better investor insights.
how_its_made:
DN404 and ERC404 Tokens:
ERC-404, developed by the Pandora team, revolutionized NFT trading by merging ERC-20 tokens with NFTs to enable native fractionalization. However, the rise of ERC-404 was marred by high Ethereum transaction fees, leading to the development of DN404 as a more cost-effective alternative.

FairLaunch and Bonding Curves:
Both ERC-404 and DN404 tokens use bonding curves to determine token prices in a decentralized manner, adjusting prices based on supply and demand. This creates a transparent, real-time pricing mechanism, ensuring continuous liquidity and fair distribution, much like automated market makers (AMMs) such as Uniswap.

Initial Future Offering (IFO):
The IFO improves upon the Initial DEX Offering (IDO) by making tokens available on a perpetual DEX. This allows users to go long or short on tokens, providing deeper market insights and enhancing security.
